title: Protocol for isolation and functional validation of label-retaining quiescent colorectal cancer stem cells from patient-derived organoids for RNA-seq
protocol: Use a P1000 micropipette tip to detach and break up Matrigel dome organoid cultures.
Create a Matrigel-organoid suspension within the Complete PDO Culture Medium.
Transfer the Matrigel-organoid suspension(s) to a 15 mL Falcon tube.
Rinse each well with an additional 1 mL of Basic PDO Culture Media to collect any residual Matrigel-organoid fragments.
Combine multiple wells of the same PDO model in a single 15 mL Falcon tube.
Add the residual Matrigel-organoid suspension to a 15 mL Falcon tube.
Triturate the mixture for 30 seconds with a P1000 tip.
Centrifuge at 300×g for 3 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant carefully, including any remaining Matrigel.
Resuspend the organoid pellet in 200 μL of TrypLE Express.
Incubate at 37°C for 15 minutes.
Triturate with a P200 tip every 5 minutes during incubation.
Add 100 μg/mL DNase I to TrypLE Express if necessary to prevent cell clumping.
Stop the effect of TrypLE Express by adding 2 mL of Basic PDO Culture Medium.
Centrifuge at 300×g for 3 minutes after addition of culture medium.
Remove the supernatant carefully and resuspend cells in 1 mL of Basic PDO Culture Media.
Label single cells with PKH26 dye.
Dilute 10 μL of cell suspension with 10 μL of trypan blue.
Place 10 μL into a hemocytometer to count live cells.
Prepare a 2 × 10^7 per mL single cell suspension in Basic PDO Culture Media in a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Centrifuge at 300×g for 3 min.
Carefully remove the supernatant with a micropipette leaving no more than 25 μL of supernatant in the tube.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL of Diluent C with gentle trituration using a P1000 tip.
Add 4 μL of PKH26 dye to 1 mL of Diluent C and mix well.
Immediately after preparation, add the 1 mL cell suspension to the 1 mL dye solution.
Instantly triturate the mixture with a P1000 tip for uniform dispersion.
Incubate the cell-dye suspension for 2–3 minutes, trituration every 30 seconds.
Stop staining by adding the cell-dye solution to a 15 mL Falcon tube containing 8 mL of 10% FCS DMEM/F12 and incubate at room temperature (20°C–22°C) for 1 minute.
Centrifuge the mixture at 400×g for 5 minutes, carefully remove supernatant.
Resuspend in 10 mL of Basic PDO Culture Media and transfer to a fresh 15 mL Falcon tube.
Centrifuge again at 300×g for 5 minutes, remove supernatant.
Wash cells twice more with 10 mL Basic PDO Culture Media to ensure removal of unbound dye.
For flow cytometric evaluation, remove 500 μL of cell suspension before the final wash step.
Transfer 500 μL of cell suspension to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube and centrifuge at 300×g for 3 min.
Resuspend cells in 500 μL Basic PDO Culture Media containing a 1:10,000 DAPI dilution.
Pass the resuspended cells through a 70 μm cell strainer into FACS tubes.
Place the FACS tubes on ice (for up to 3 h) and proceed with flow cytometric analysis.
Centrifuge at 300×g for 3 min and place the 15 mL Falcon containing the stained cell pellet on ice.
Resuspend cells on ice in an appropriate volume of Matrigel, e.g., 120 μL per well of a 6-well plate.
Remove pre-warmed 6-well plates from the incubator.
Add 120 μL of Matrigel-cell suspension to the center of each well.
Increase the volume of Matrigel added to resuspend the cell pellet.
Add 12 μL of Matrigel-cell suspension per well of a 48-well plate.
Allow Matrigel to set at 37°C for 10 min in the incubator.
Overlay solidified Matrigel domes with 2 mL of Complete PDO Culture Media.
Visually inspect and record PKH26 labeling under a fluorescence microscope.
Culture plates at 37°C for 12 days, changing media every 2 days.
Isolate PKH26 label-retaining cells after 12 days in culture.
Visually inspect Matrigel domes with a fluorescence microscope after 12 days in culture.
Remove supernatant carefully from PDOs.
Resuspend pellet in 5 mL Basic PDO Culture Media containing a 1:10,000 DAPI dilution.
Pass the resuspended cells through a 70 μm cell strainer into FACS tubes.
Place the strained sample on ice.
Prepare unstained and single stained cells as compensation controls for FACS.
Load the sample tube onto the FACS machine.
Create a gating strategy to isolate and sort single live DAPI-negative PKH26-positive non-cycling LRCs.
Adjust FSC and SSC photomultiplier tube settings to ensure visibility of all cells.
Set and adjust the FSC Threshold to remove cellular debris with low forward scatter.
Apply "all cells" gate onto a FSC-H vs. FSC-A (or FSC-W) plot to exclude doublets and multiplets.
Create a FSC vs. DAPI plot.
Apply the “singlets” gate onto the FSC vs. DAPI plot.
Create a gate around the DAPINegative cells and label it “live cells”.
Create a FSC vs PKH26 (PE) plot.
Apply the “live cells” gate to the FSC vs PKH26 (PE) plot.
Use the negative control to set the positive and negative gates and discern the positive signal from background fluorescence.
Perform a purity check and make any necessary technical adjustments before proceeding with collection of cell subpopulations.
Proceed with FACS collection of cellular subpopulations for functional testing.
Proceed with RNA-sequencing as described below.
Set the gate for PKH26Positive/High cells at the far end of the PKH26Positive cell dot plot to exclude PKH26Positive/Low cells if necessary.
Consider extending the culture period to allow further dye dilution before proceeding with FACS isolation steps if a large number of PKH26Positive/Low cells are observed.
Prepare 384-well non-adherent ultra-low attachment plates by adding 100 μl Complete PDO Culture Media per well.
Sort single live PKH26Negative cells and PKH26Positive LRCs directly into 384-well plates at a frequency of one cell per well.
Visually inspect each well with a microscope to confirm the presence of a single cell per well.
Incubate plates at 37°C and culture for up to 20 days.
Count the number of spheroids formed by PKH26Negative cells and PKH26Positive LRCs.
Calculate CSC frequency using ELDA software.
Sort live PKH26Negative cells and PKH26Positive LRCs separately into chilled FACS collection tubes containing 500 μL Complete PDO Culture Media.
Dilute 10 μL of each cell suspension with 10 μL of trypan blue.
Place 10 μL into a hemocytometer to count live cells.
Transfer the sorted cell suspensions to 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes and centrifuge at 4°C at 300×g for 3 min.
Resuspend cells at a concentration of 100 live cells per 5 μL Matrigel.
Include an additional 10% cells and Matrigel in the overall volume to account for loss during pipetting.
Remove pre-warmed 96-well plates from the incubator.
Add 5 μL of Matrigel-cell suspension to the center of each well.
Keep pipette tips chilled when pipetting small volumes of Matrigel into large multi-well plate formats.
Overlay each well with 100 μL Complete PDO Culture Media and incubate for 12 days.
Wait for organoids to begin forming before changing media.
Change media every 2 days.
Image each well with a microscope.
Measure organoid size using ImageJ software.
Use CellTiter-Glo viability assay to determine differences in cell proliferation between PKH26Negative cell-derived PDOs and PKH26Positive LRC-derived PDOs.
Prepare RNA-seq libraries using the Ovation RNA-Seq System V2 and Ultralow V2 Library System.
Alternatively, prepare libraries with the Universal Plus Total RNA-Seq library preparation kit with NuQaunt (Tecan).
Amplify cDNA from total RNA according to manufacturer’s instructions for whole transcriptome RNA amplification.
Prepare amplified cDNA for sequencing using appropriate library preparation methods.
Collect DAPINegative PKH26Negative cells and DAPINegative PKH26Positive LRCs by FACS from four different biological replicates.
Transfer collected cells into collection tubes containing RLT lysis buffer at 4°C.
Optional: For single cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq), collect cells in Complete PDO Culture Media.
Load single cell suspensions onto a 10× Chromium platform for scRNA-seq.
Process samples for RNA using an RNeasy Plus RNA extraction kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Quantify the amount of RNA recovered using a Qubit instrument or Nanodrop.
